rapport_notes: Excellent — warm and unhurried through a genuinely complex three-stop move (storage + apartment + house), answered a first-responder-discount question honestly.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before we start. I just wanted to check if you have any important concerns about this specific move that you also want us to discuss on this call." — asked right after getting contact info, before any logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a real concern about needing pickup from two locations; rep confirmed it was doable and explained the hourly-billing implications, but didn't ask a further "anything else on your mind" follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "Once we go over the minimum, we only charge in fifteen minute intervals."

top_strength: Delivered the full Stage 2 Communication takeaway unprompted — explicitly promised a day-before check-in call — one of only a few calls in the batch to actually close that loop.
coaching_note: The multi-stop concern got a direct, competent answer but no deeper follow-up question — add one before moving into stop-by-stop logistics to lock in full two-layer credit.
